<a id="clear_play_area"></a>
### [`clear_play_area`](../../../../src/screen/clear_play_area.asm#L6) `$8720`

*routine*

Turns off all sprites and fills the rows 0-21 with spaces in the colour $05. On exit, $03 is 22.

- **Called from:** [`setup_screen`](../setup/setup_screen.md#setup_screen) [`$7CE1`](../../../../src/setup/setup_screen.asm#L9), [`clear_player_states`](../game/player_turn.md#clear_player_states) [`$8672`](../../../../src/game/player_turn.asm#L16), [`borrow_mower_scene`](../game/borrow_mower_scene.md#borrow_mower_scene) [`$8757`](../../../../src/game/borrow_mower_scene.asm#L20), [`setup_lawn`](../lawn/setup_lawn.md#setup_lawn) [`$8AC2`](../../../../src/lawn/setup_lawn.asm#L7), [`save_lawn_scroll_out`](../neighbour/neighbour_catch.md#save_lawn_scroll_out) [`$98D0`](../../../../src/neighbour/neighbour_catch.asm#L181), [`init_hiscores`](../scores/hiscores.md#init_hiscores) [`$9E12`](../../../../src/scores/hiscores.asm#L52), [`$9FA0`](../../../../src/title/attract_loop.asm#L7), [`show_hiscore_screen`](../title/attract_loop.md#show_hiscore_screen) [`$9FAC`](../../../../src/title/attract_loop.asm#L14)
